note: *porque para sempre não será abalado*: the third stylist to ask *jamais será abalado*, which drops *in ætérnum*'s word (D23). Open for Gustavo with 14:5b and 124:1 (HANDOFF).
*até que olhe de cima os seus inimigos* was heard as social condescension; the stylist's *olhe do alto* is the option. The *despícere* row keeps height and contempt together.
